title: Dependency edge
description: One recorded fact about what a locus cites, one level down. A record with cites null means the locus was read and names no work; a locus with no record at all has not been audited. Records are made by whoever audits — a person, or an assistant at a person's direction — named in recorded_by, and appended, never edited once released. Kit v1.4. CC0 1.0.

id.description: Stable identifier of this record. Never reused.

locus.description: The id of the locus (paragraph, heading or footnote) that does the citing, as written by loci.py.

cites.description: The work cited, by issuer and title. null: the locus was read and cites no work.

how.description: How the citation was recognised, quoting the words as printed: named in the text, described without a title, in a footnote, in a figure's or table's source line.

status_subject.description: The subject under which the cited work's status is kept in the status log, if it is kept there.

status_component.description: Which status component to read. Defaults to existence.
